mainEntity.name: What types of treatments does CFHH offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: CFHH offers a combination of evidence-based and holistic therapies, focusing on mental health, mindfulness, and overall well-being. Treatments include cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), ketamine treatment, medications for opioid recovery, yoga, and psychoeducation.

mainEntity.name: Is the Centres for Health and Healing a 12-Step program?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, CFHH employs a non-12-Step approach to treatment, acknowledging that not everyone’s values align with the traditional 12-Step program.
CFHH is situated in Vaughan, Ontario, on 110 acres of serene Canadian countryside with a picturesque lakeside setting.

mainEntity.name: How does CFHH ensure privacy and security for clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: CFHH features a gated entrance, which guarantees privacy and security for clients. The secluded property offers a tranquil oasis away from the hustle and bustle of daily life.

Yes, CFHH is a technology-friendly facility, recognizing the needs of working professionals and those with young children. However, they request clients to be technology-free for the first week of their stay, with flexible arrangements available if needed.

mainEntity.name: Does CFHH involve family in the treatment process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, CFHH prioritizes family involvement and offers a family group program every Saturday. They believe that family support, care, and education are essential aspects of lasting recovery.

mainEntity.name: What leisure activities are available at CFHH?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clients can enjoy a range of peaceful activities at CFHH, such as pedal boating on the lake, watching the sunset from the dock, or simply relaxing in the various outdoor seating areas.

mainEntity.name: What kind of staff does CFHH have?

acceptedAnswer.text: CFHH’s expert staff includes nurses, counselors, interventionists, case managers, and professional chefs who work together to create personalized and effective treatment plans for each client.

mainEntity.name: How much does Centres for Health and Healing cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Although treatment costs can fluctuate based on factors such as program length and insurance benefits, the average price is typically around $22,500. The cost of treatment at Centres for Health and Healing (CFHH) depends on various aspects, including the chosen program, the duration of the stay, and the required care level. To obtain the most precise and current pricing details, it is advisable to get in touch with CFHH directly. Their well-informed team can discuss your unique needs, offer comprehensive pricing information, and help you explore any financial assistance options or insurance coverage that might be accessible to you.

about_blocks.text: Centres for Health and Healing (CFHH), experience a luxurious retreat-style sanctuary, complete with a private indoor swimming pool, outdoor lounge, multiple alfresco seating areas, and exclusive lake views. The gated entrance ensures the utmost privacy and security for clients. CFHH employs a non-12-Step approach to treatment, recognizing that not everyone’s values align with the traditional 12-Step program. The center emphasizes mental health, mindfulness, and a blend of evidence-based and holistic therapies, while offering individual and group counseling sessions for enhanced connections and bonding.

The center also values family involvement, offering a family group program every Saturday to foster support, care, and education as crucial components of lasting recovery.

about_blocks.text: Settled on 110 acres of farmland, Centres for Health and Healing offers a holistic and non-12 step treatment approach and a variety of water activities. Vaughan Recovery House is one of two addiction treatment centres in Ontario run by Centres for Health and Healing (CFHH). This is a residential addiction rehab centre offering detox and primary care in a relaxed, intimate and homely setting. Tackle alcoholism, drug addiction, concurrent disorders, depression and other issues in a safe and nurturing environment, where each client can follow their own personalized treatment plan with 24/7 dedicated and professional support. Our private, residential facility is set in a quiet, gated community for the security and privacy of our clients. With just 16 beds, we provide a cosy, home-from-home feel, with a communal TV lounge/group room, fully equipped kitchen and dining area, gardens and sports
